request.style: English, female soul voice, warm and intimate, solo with gospel choir backing, electric piano, upright bass, acoustic guitar, light percussion, gentle and hopeful mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not burn with anger over evildoers
Do not envy those who do wrong
Like grass they will soon wither and fade
Like the green of new growth gone

[Chorus]
Take your delight in the LORD
And he will give you what your heart asks
Take your delight in the LORD
Trust in him and rest in his ways

[Verse]
Trust in the LORD and do good
Dwell in the land and make faithfulness your pasture
Commit your way to the LORD
And trust in him, he will act

[Chorus]
Take your delight in the LORD
And he will give you what your heart asks
Take your delight in the LORD
Trust in him and rest in his ways

[Bridge]
He will bring out your righteousness like the light
And your justice like the noonday sun
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently
Do not burn with anger over the one whose way prospers

[Outro]
Take your delight in the LORD
He will act
